newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eiffel Tower reopens after strike.
newsitem.headline: Eiffel Tower reopens after strike.

text.p: Paris's Eiffel Tower has reopened after a two-day strike over the sacking of an employee accused by a British woman tourist of manhandling her, operators said on Friday.

A spokeswoman said the tower, with 5.5 million visitors a year one of the world's leading tourist attractions, reopened after officials promised to find a new job in another firm for the sacked employee. He disputes the circumstances of the incident.

Tower operators, who run the 320-metre (1,050 ft) monument with a concession from the owner, the city of Paris, say the 60-year-old employee shoved the woman back when she tried to get out of a lift as the doors were about to close. She says she suffered vertigo.
